aka.en: El Camino East–West Corridor (Brunswick to Roscoe)
aka.zh: 东西王家大道走廊（不伦瑞克至罗斯科）

tagline.en: A 1926 Wiregrass road that grew west to the San Juan Mountains, crossing the Mississippi at Natchez
tagline.zh: 一条 1926 年的“线草地区”公路，向西一路延伸到圣胡安山，在纳奇兹跨越密西西比河

start.en: US 160 on the eastern edge of Pagosa Springs, Colorado
start.zh: 科罗拉多州帕戈萨斯普林斯东缘，与 US 160 相接

end.en: I-95 exit 76, east of Midway, Georgia; the road carries on towards the coast as a county road
end.zh: 佐治亚州米德韦以东，I-95 第 76 号出口；道路以县道之名继续通往海岸

en: US 84 crosses seven states between the San Juan Mountains and the Georgia coast. Its western end is a mountain road: south from Pagosa Springs through the San Juan National Forest, over the Continental Divide at a low 7,718-foot pass, through Chama and down the Chama and Rio Grande valleys to Española and Santa Fe. It follows I-25 round the end of the Sangre de Cristo range and I-40 to Santa Rosa, then crosses the eastern New Mexico plains through Fort Sumner and Clovis. Between Fort Sumner and Colorado New Mexico signs it north–south.

In Texas it runs south-east across the Llano Estacado through Muleshoe and Lubbock, then east by Snyder, Abilene, Brownwood and Waco to Palestine and the Louisiana line at Logansport. East of the Sabine it is a two-lane road through the Louisiana pinelands — Mansfield, Coushatta, Winnfield, Jena, Ferriday — to the Mississippi at Vidalia and Natchez, then across southern Mississippi and Alabama through Brookhaven, Laurel, Grove Hill, Andalusia, Enterprise and Dothan, the Wiregrass country, and across south Georgia by Bainbridge, Thomasville, Valdosta, Waycross and Jesup.

Five state legislatures have designated the section from Brunswick, Georgia, to Roscoe, Texas, as the El Camino East–West Corridor, recalling an old migration route from the Atlantic towards Mexico and promoting the road for tourism and trade.
zh: US 84 在圣胡安山与佐治亚海岸之间穿越七个州。它的西端是一条山路：自帕戈萨斯普林斯南下，穿过圣胡安国家森林，在海拔仅 7,718 英尺的山口越过大陆分水岭，经查马沿查马河与格兰德河谷地而下，到达埃斯帕尼奥拉与圣菲。它随 I-25 绕过桑格累德克里斯托山脉的末端，再随 I-40 到圣罗莎，然后经萨姆纳堡与克洛维斯横穿新墨西哥东部平原。在萨姆纳堡至科罗拉多之间，新墨西哥把它标为南北向。

在得克萨斯，它向东南横越埃斯塔卡多平原，经马尔舒与拉伯克，再东行经斯奈德、阿比林、布朗伍德与韦科到巴勒斯坦，在洛根斯波特抵达路易斯安那州界。萨宾河以东，它是穿过路易斯安那松林的双车道公路——曼斯菲尔德、库沙塔、温菲尔德、杰纳、费里迪——在维达利亚与纳奇兹之间跨越密西西比河，再横穿密西西比与亚拉巴马南部，经布鲁克黑文、劳雷尔、格罗夫希尔、安达卢西亚、恩特普赖斯与多森，即所谓“线草地区”，然后经班布里奇、托马斯维尔、瓦尔多斯塔、韦克罗斯与杰瑟普横贯佐治亚南部。
五个州的议会已把佐治亚州不伦瑞克至得克萨斯州罗斯科一段定为“东西王家大道走廊”，以纪念一条从大西洋沿岸通往墨西哥方向的古老迁徙路线，并借此推广旅游与贸易。

en: The US 84 of 1926 ran only from Dothan, Alabama, to Brunswick, Georgia, about 281 miles. It was then pushed west in stages: in 1934 AASHO extended it to Texico, New Mexico, with a ferry across the Mississippi at Natchez; in 1937 to Cortez, Colorado, though it may not have been signed beyond Santa Fe; and in 1941 north from Santa Fe to Pagosa Springs instead.

The extension across Mississippi and Alabama existed on paper before it did on the ground. There was no bridge over the Tombigbee west of Coffeeville, so until about the mid-1950s through traffic was directed south from Waynesboro on US 45 to State Line, east through Chatom to Wagarville and north on US 43 to Grove Hill. AASHO approved the direct route in 1965.

The eastern end moved in 1988. Georgia asked to swap US 84 and US 82 east of Waycross to give both routes better continuity, so US 84 now runs north-east by Jesup and Hinesville to I-95 at Midway, and Brunswick is served by US 82.
zh: 1926 年的 US 84 只从亚拉巴马州多森通到佐治亚州不伦瑞克，约 281 英里。此后它分阶段西延：1934 年 AASHO 把它延伸至新墨西哥州特克斯科，在纳奇兹以渡轮跨越密西西比河；1937 年延伸至科罗拉多州科特斯，但圣菲以西可能并未设标志；1941 年改为自圣菲北上至帕戈萨斯普林斯。
穿越密西西比与亚拉巴马的延伸段先存在于纸面，后才落到地面。科菲维尔以西的汤比格比河上没有桥，于是直到 1950 年代中期前后，过境车辆被引导自韦恩斯伯勒沿 US 45 南下至州线镇，东行经查特姆至瓦加维尔，再沿 US 43 北上到格罗夫希尔。1965 年，AASHO 批准了直达线位。
东端于 1988 年移动。佐治亚请求在韦克罗斯以东对调 US 84 与 US 82，使两条路线的方向更连贯；于是 US 84 改为经杰瑟普与海恩斯维尔向东北通往米德韦的 I-95，不伦瑞克则改由 US 82 服务。

en: The Natchez–Vidalia crossing replaced the ferry in 1940. The bridge, designed by Ash-Howard-Needles & Tammen and built as Works Progress Administration project 1126, was the first highway-only bridge over the Mississippi south of St. Louis. Its roadway is 24 feet wide between the curbs, and since a downstream twin was completed in July 1988 it has been striped as two westbound lanes.

Mississippi maintains the pair, and the cost is shared equally with Louisiana. A 2010 inspection found that pins in the old bridge's eyebar links had begun to shift; rather than replace the span, which was estimated at $250 million, the two states replaced two of its eight links and four pins in a $3.8 million contract.
zh: 1940 年，纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥取代了渡轮。大桥由 Ash-Howard-Needles & Tammen 设计，作为公共事业振兴署第 1126 号工程修建，是圣路易斯以南第一座仅供公路使用的密西西比河大桥。它的路缘间行车道宽 24 英尺；1988 年 7 月下游的孪生桥建成后，老桥改划为两条西行车道。
两座桥由密西西比养护，费用与路易斯安那平摊。2010 年的检查发现，老桥眼杆连杆中的销轴已开始移位；两州没有选择造价估计 2.5 亿美元的重建，而是以一份 380 万美元的合同更换了八根连杆中的两根及四根销轴。

why.en: No figure exists. US 84 was numbered over existing state roads from 1926 to 1941 and has been rebuilt piecemeal by seven states; only individual works such as the Natchez–Vidalia Bridge were costed on their own.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 84 于 1926 至 1941 年间沿既有州道编号，此后由七个州分段陆续改建；只有纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥之类的单项工程留有独立造价。

why.en: There is no single funder. Each state pays for its sections with state and federal-aid money; the Natchez–Vidalia Bridge is maintained by Mississippi with costs shared equally with Louisiana.
why.zh: 没有单一出资方。各州以州资金与联邦补助负担各自路段；纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥由密西西比养护，费用与路易斯安那平摊。

label.zh: 纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥（1940 年）

value.en: Original construction cost $3.56 million, built for the City of Natchez as WPA project 1126
value.zh: 原始造价 356 万美元，作为公共事业振兴署第 1126 号工程为纳奇兹市修建

figures.source: HNTB, HNTB Designer no. 105, project quick facts

value.en: $3.8 million contract to C.E.C. of Lafayette, Louisiana, against an estimated $250 million for a replacement bridge
value.zh: 380 万美元合同，由路易斯安那州拉斐特的 C.E.C. 公司承建；重建新桥的估价为 2.5 亿美元

figures.source: AISC, US 84 Mississippi River Bridge truss pin and link replacement paper; HNTB Designer no. 105

value.en: Reported at 1,919 miles end to end from the state subtotals in AASHTO's 1989 route log, and measured at 1,905.0 miles in 2016, both as given by US Ends; not checked against the 1989 log itself
value.zh: 据报按 AASHTO 1989 年路线里程表各州分项合计，端到端为 1,919 英里；2016 年实测 1,905.0 英里，两数均出自 US Ends；未与 1989 年里程表原件核对

why.en: Seven state agencies count their own sections and publish no combined figure for US 84.
why.zh: 七个州的机构各自统计本州路段，并无 US 84 的全线合并数字发布。

timeline.en: US 84 is numbered from Dothan, Alabama, to Brunswick, Georgia.
timeline.zh: US 84 编定，自亚拉巴马州多森至佐治亚州不伦瑞克。

timeline.en: AASHO extends US 84 west to Texico, New Mexico, using a ferry across the Mississippi at Natchez.
timeline.zh: AASHO 把 US 84 西延至新墨西哥州特克斯科，在纳奇兹以渡轮跨越密西西比河。

timeline.en: The designation is extended to Cortez, Colorado.
timeline.zh: 编号延伸至科罗拉多州科特斯。

timeline.en: The Natchez–Vidalia Bridge opens in September and replaces the ferry.
timeline.zh: 9 月，纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥通车，取代渡轮。

timeline.en: US 84 is routed north from Santa Fe to its present end at Pagosa Springs.
timeline.zh: US 84 改为自圣菲北上，至今日终点帕戈萨斯普林斯。

timeline.en: AASHO approves the direct route between Waynesboro, Mississippi, and Grove Hill, Alabama.
timeline.zh: AASHO 批准密西西比州韦恩斯伯勒至亚拉巴马州格罗夫希尔的直达线位。

timeline.en: A twin span opens at Natchez in July, and US 84 is swapped with US 82 east of Waycross, moving its eastern end from Brunswick to Midway.
timeline.zh: 7 月纳奇兹孪生桥通车；US 84 与 US 82 在韦克罗斯以东对调，东端自不伦瑞克移至米德韦。

timeline.en: An in-depth inspection finds shifting pins in the 1940 Natchez–Vidalia Bridge, leading to the link replacement.
timeline.zh: 深入检查发现 1940 年纳奇兹—维达利亚大桥的销轴移位，随后进行了连杆更换。
